KO.rationale: Coca-Cola is a high-quality, defensive franchise with excellent brand moat, asset-light concentrate model, and a 64-year dividend increase streak. Q1 2026 showed strong momentum (organic revenue +10%, comparable EPS +18% YoY), and management raised FY2026 guidance to 8-9% comparable EPS growth. ROE of ~40% and gross margins above 61% reflect durable competitive advantages. However, the stock is trading at the top of its 1-year P/E range (30x vs. 23-30x window), and P/B of 12.1x is also at the high end (9.4-12.1x). The stock has rallied +12.8% in the last quarter alone, reaching all-time highs near $85. This means the market is already paying a premium for the defensive quality and growth trajectory. The Fairlife ransomware incident (disclosed July 16) introduces a near-term operational risk, though materiality is not yet determined. The $20B IRS tax dispute remains an overhang. With the stock at peak multiples and no clear undervaluation vs. its own history, the risk/reward is balanced rather than compelling. A mild positive score reflects the excellent fundamental health offset by rich valuation.
